meta.title: TCF Simulator - Practise the TCF under real exam conditions
meta.description: 5 complete mock TCF tests, timed like exam day. Score, CEFR level and a detailed correction of every mistake.

hero.subtitle: Fidelity to exam day: server-side timer, autosave, resume after any interruption. Score, estimated CEFR level and an explanation for every mistake.

features.title: A simulation, not a quiz
features.subtitle: Every detail mirrors the exam: time pressure, document reading, immediate analysis of your mistakes.
features.timerBody: Remaining time is computed by the server. Reloading the page, losing the network or switching devices costs you nothing.
features.autosaveBody: Every answer is stored immediately. You resume at exactly the same point.
features.correctionBody: For each question: your answer, the right answer, and above all why. Mistakes turn into progress.
features.analyticsBody: Radar by level, bars by difficulty, time spent per question and a progress curve across the 5 tests.
features.mistakesBody: A targeted session on the questions you got wrong, instead of repeating the whole test.
features.mobileBody: Fully responsive design and an installable app (PWA). Revise on the metro, online or offline.

exam.title: Two modules, like the TCF
exam.subtitle: Each module is timed separately. You move forward one question at a time.
exam.structureBody: Grammar, vocabulary, morphology: complete the sentence with the correct form.
exam.comprehensionBody: Notices, emails, articles, leaflets: read a document then answer its questions.

howItWorks.step2Body: Timer, navigation grid, flag for review, saved on every click.
howItWorks.step3Body: Score per module, estimated CEFR level and a commented correction question by question.

testsPreview.title: Five tests to measure your progress

testimonials.title: What our candidates say
testimonials.placeholderNote: Demo testimonials - replace with your verifiable feedback.
testimonials.t1Quote: The server-side timer changed everything: I finally understood how I react under pressure, not just what I know.
testimonials.t2Quote: Retrying only my mistakes gained me two levels in three weeks. The explanations are precise, not generic.

faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.a1: No. They are original questions created for practice, inspired by the general format of the public TCF. Only France Education international and an accredited centre can award the official TCF.
faq.q2: How is the CEFR level computed?
faq.a2: Using a configurable scale defined in the application code. It is a pedagogical approximation for practice, not the official TCF scale.
faq.q3: What happens if I lose my connection?
faq.a3: Your answers are already stored server-side. Saving resumes as soon as the connection is back. The timer, however, stays authoritative on the server.
faq.q4: Can I pause a test and resume later?
faq.a4: Yes. Each module has its own timer. If you close the page you will find the in-progress attempt with the exact remaining time, as long as the module duration has not elapsed.
faq.q5: How long does a full test take?
faq.a5: 80 minutes in total: 20 minutes for language structure (20 questions) and 60 minutes for reading comprehension (30 questions).
faq.a6: Yes, an account is needed to keep your results, history and progress curve. You can also sign in with Google.
